NAME
       aws -

DESCRIPTION
       The  AWS  Command  Line  Interface is a unified tool to manage your AWS
       services.

SYNOPSIS
          aws [options] <command> <subcommand> [parameters]

GLOBAL OPTIONS
       --debug (boolean)

       Turn on debug logging.

AVAILABLE SERVICES
       + o accessanalyzer

       + o cloudformation

       + o ec2

SEE ALSO
       aws help topics
